data.description:
## What
Add a `mirror-defenses-to-pr` job to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs before the `llm-review` job.

## Changes to ci.yml

### New job: mirror-defenses-to-pr
```yaml
mirror-defenses-to-pr:
  name: Mirror Tracker Defenses to PR
  needs: [changes, test-hooks, test-scripts]
  if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main'
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  timeout-minutes: 5
  continue-on-error: true  # Mirror failure must not block llm-review
  permissions:
    contents: read
    pull-requests: write
  steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Mirror defenses to PR
      if: needs.changes.outputs.code_changed == 'true'
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        PR_NUMBER="${GITHUB_REF#refs/pull/}"
        PR_NUMBER="${PR_NUMBER%/merge}"
        # Extract ticket IDs from PR body/branch (heuristic: look for ticket comments)
        bash plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh "$PR_NUMBER" || true
```

### Update llm-review job
Add `mirror-defenses-to-pr` to `llm-review`'s `needs:`:
```yaml
needs: [changes, test-hooks, test-scripts, mirror-defenses-to-pr]
```

## Key constraints
- `continue-on-error: true` on mirror-defenses-to-pr job — mirror failure must NOT block llm-review
- Only runs on pull_request events (same guard as llm-review)
- GITHUB_TOKEN permissions: pull-requests: write (to post comments)
- `needs.changes.outputs.code_changed` check prevents no-op runs

## Acceptance Criteria
- ci.yml contains a `mirror-defenses-to-pr` job
- llm-review job's needs list includes mirror-defenses-to-pr
- actionlint passes on modified ci.yml

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — ci.yml configuration change

## File Impact
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (modify)
